messages:
oliver: FYI SFO reported sustained degraded GPU availability starting 03:14 UTC. Affected priority=standard pools, autoscaler kept adding nodes but provisioning failed on some zones.
maria: I saw the alerts — nvlink errors on two racks, kernel oopss on one host. We drained 6 nodes.
jaime: Adding context: cloud provider had a maintenance window that overlapped our AZ C reboot sequence; our placement policy ended up concentrating scale requests into remaining racks.
kevin: Can we confirm customer impact? Any 5xx spikes on hosted API?
oliver: Small but noticeable 502/504 spike for long-context gen workloads between 03:20–03:48 UTC. Latency SLO breaches for a handful of tenants, routed to fallback small models.
maria: Mitigation timeline: 03:18 started cross-AZ traffic-shift to SJC, 03:22 enabled aggressive cache warmup, 03:30 increased burst capacity in SJC, 03:46 completed drain of faulty racks.
jaime: Lessons for runbook: 1) Placement policy needs AZ-aware spread with soft cap per-rack. 2) Autoscaler should fall back to different AZ earlier if rack failures reach threshold. 3) Preflight checks before provider maintenance windows.
oliver: Proposed immediate runbook updates (short):
- add step: on >=3 node failures in a rack, trigger "zone-spread" traffic policy and open a pager to infra oncall
- add check: provider-maintenance signals -> postpone non-critical reboots by 30m
- add command snip for manual traffic shift:
```
# shift 40% of traffic from sfo to sjc for route /v1/generate
redwood-trafficctl shift --route /v1/generate --from sfo --to sjc --percent 40 --grace 120
```
maria: Suggested followups: run a tabletop on cross-AZ rebalance, and add unit tests for placement heuristics in the simulator. Also flag cost bucket: the burst to SJC added unexpected spot costs (~$1.8k in 2h).
kevin: For post-incident action items: 1) update runbook (oliver) 2) simulator test (maria) 3) billing postmortem (finance) 4) infra change PR for autoscaler (jaime).
jaime: I'll open the autoscaler PR and include a feature toggle. Will add metrics for "rack-failure-rate".
oliver: I'll draft the runbook edits today and send a PR to ops/runbooks. Also adding a preflight provider-signal subscription to our alerting.
maria: I'll schedule a tabletop for next Wed 16:00 UTC and create the simulator test ticket.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: ops/runbooks PR#432 submitted by oliver at 12:05 UTC.
kevin: Thx all. Can someone call out any permanent config changes we should avoid (cost/latency tradeoffs)?
\oliver: Avoid permanently raising cross-region burst by default. Use policy-controlled bursts with cost caps.
maria: Agreed. Also consider a lightweight instance class for warm pools to reduce cold-start risk without full GPU cost.
jaime: Noted. Will include cost cap config and a toggle in the PR.
kevin: OK closing thread for now — monitor SFO for 24h and update on any regressions. :thumbsup:
